jobs.company: NTT Global Data Centers Americas, Inc.
jobs.description:
NTT Global Data Centers Americas, Inc. is seeking an experienced Security Officer L1 to reinforce a site security team at our Chicago-area facility. You will manage access control, observe all activities, respond to incidents, and prepare detailed shift reports.

Collaboration with DCOPS and other departments is essential to maintain smooth operations. The role requires a high school diploma or GED, security certifications, and at least one year in security.

jobs.title: Data Center Security Officer: Access, CCTV & Safety
jobs.company: NTT Global Data Centers Americas, Inc.
jobs.description:
NTT Global Data Centers Americas, Inc. seeks a Security Officer Level 1 to support security operations at a Chicago-area data center.

You will enforce access control, monitor CCTV, respond to incidents, and prepare concise written reports while coordinating with the DCOPS team. The role requires effective communication, teamwork, and the ability to work a Wednesday 1pm-7pm shift and a Thursday–Saturday 7am–7pm schedule.

jobs.title: Data Center Security Specialist I On-Site
jobs.company: NTT Global Data Centers Americas, Inc.
jobs.description:
NTT Global Data Centers Americas, Inc. is seeking a Security Officer Level 1 for a Sunday–Tuesday 7am–7pm shift at our Chicago data center. You will manage access, monitor CCTV, and respond to incidents to protect personnel and property.

You will collaborate with DCOPS and other teams, complete reports, and uphold security procedures while maintaining a professional client-facing presence and adherence to PPE and safety rules.
